subject: Web 'MPD settings' card: the three team-model slot pickers show ONLY the provider deepseek-official although the host catalog carries opencode-go (27 models).
verdict: REPRODUCED in a real browser (Chrome for Testing 149 over CDP) against a real, isolated dsh web host. rootCause.cordisMechanism: @deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js — createTraceable(ctx, value, tracker): `if (prop === tracker.property) return ctx` (the service's own `ctx` resolves to the ACCESSING ctx), and `if (tracker.associate && ctx.reflect.props[tracker.associate + '.' + prop]) return Reflect.get(ctx, tracker.associate + '.' + prop, …)` (so `.session` on `remote` is read as the dotted service key "remote.session" ON THE CALLER). The reflect trap throws `cannot get property "<prop>" without inject` when the caller's fiber store has no entry for that key.
rootCause.hostServiceContract: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection/lib/client.js — class ModelDirectoryResolver declares `static inject = ["sessions","remote","remote.session"]`, and `directoryFor(sessionId)` constructs `new ModelDirectory(this.ctx.remote.session, …)` and also reads `this.ctx.sessions`.
